guidance.heading: Financial Outlook and Guidance
section: Tempus is increasing its full year 2026 revenue guidance to $1.60 to $1.605 billion, which represents ~25% annual growth. We continue to expect 2026 Adjusted EBITDA to be ~$65 million.
For additional information on the quarter, including a letter from our CEO and CFO, please visit our investor relations site at investors.tempus.com.
